description: Warm, curious female investigator; synthetic British English voice

cues.text: One crucial paper. Missing. Let's investigate.
Every citation checked out. Yet one crucial paper was missing.
Let's follow the evidence. From the answer… back to the search.
There it is. Still in the index. It never reached the candidate list.
Reranking can't rescue a paper it never received.
Learn to investigate the pipeline. Boolean search, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, and evaluation.
How Search Decides What You See. By Aaron Tay. Read free. Case reopened.
